dogecoin.text: @Investments_CEO Who thinks Dogecoin is  a meme coin with no real use case, it shows a misunderstanding of what gives currency its value. The value of any currency depends on how widely it’s accepted and used. USD as an example—is  just paper, yet it holds value because people trust and use it.

@cb_doge For everyone who says Dogecoin is just a meme coin with no use case, they clearly don't understand what currency is. The value of any currency comes from how widely it's used. Take the USD, for example—it's just a piece of paper, yet it holds value because people use it.
